偏る: to be unbalanced (e.g. diet); to be unduly weighted towards; to be concentrated on
広げる: to spread; to extend; to expand; to enlarge
落ち着く: to calm down; to settle down; to die down; to become stable
見張る: to stand watch; to stand guard; to look out
仕立てる: to turn into a play or movie
取り上げる: to take away; to confiscate; to deprive (someone) of; to revoke
通ずる: to be conveyed (of an intention, meaning, etc.); to be understood (by); to be comprehended; to get across (e.g. of an idea)
口説く: to make advances (to); to seduce; to court; to woo
私服: ordinary clothes (i.e. non-uniform); plain clothes; civilian clothes; casual wear
王道: orthodox way; proper way; traditional manner; classic approach
